sn55.1:1.3: The legendary wheel-turning monarch, who ruled without violence from sea to sea, is depicted in detail in [dn17]() and [dn26]().
sn55.1:2.1: These are the four factors of stream-entry. The devotional passages that follow are regularly recited throughout Theravadin communities, and also form the basis of meditation on the triple gem.
sn55.1:2.3: _Bhagavā_ (“blessed one”, “lord”) is the normal epithet for the Buddha in Pali. The literal meaning is “one who has good fortune”, in which sense it stems from Vedic times (Rig Veda 7.41.5).
